title: Solid body
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on a new face. This sketch consists of a closed loop made up of four straight lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.0081, 0.0). The second line extends from (0.0081, 0.0) to (0.0081, 0.0185). The third line runs from (0.0081, 0.0185) to (0.0, 0.0185), and the fourth line completes the loop by going from (0.0, 0.0185) back to the origin. After drawing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.0185 to the entire sketch. Ensure that the sketch remains aligned with the original coordinate system by rotating it using Euler angles of zero degrees and translating it with a vector of zero. Finally, extrude the scaled sketch along its normal direction by 0.75 units to create a three-dimensional rectangular prism. The resulting solid body has a length of 0.008101851851851853 units, a width of 0.018518518518518517 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0081, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0081, 0.0185) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0185) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a cylinder
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
